answer:
Your Projects note is now a kanban board app. I checked it in the preview at phone and Mac widths: it loads, quick-add puts a new card in the column, and tapping a card opens its details. I didn't try dragging, the "Move to" action, search, the filters or archiving, so those are untested.

- **Boards and columns:** Switch boards from the dropdown at the top. You can add, rename and delete boards there. New boards start with To do, Doing and Done. You can rename a column by typing in its title. Use the column menu to move it left or right, or to delete it. Deleting a column moves its cards to another column. Add a column from the box at the end.
- **Cards:** Type in a column's "Add a card" box and press Enter to add one fast. Tap a card to edit its title, description, due date, labels and checklist. The details dialog also has a "Move to" dropdown, Archive and Delete.
- **Moving cards:** On the Mac, drag a card to another column or to a spot in the same column. On the phone, use the card's "…" menu: "Move to" a column, or "Move up" and "Move down" within the column.
- **Search and filters:**
  - Search covers titles, descriptions, labels and checklist items.
  - A label dropdown filters by label.
  - "Overdue" shows only overdue cards.
  - "Archive Done" archives every card in the last column, and "Archived" lets you view and restore them.
- **Done and overdue:** The last column counts as "Done". Cards in it are never marked overdue, whatever you name it.
- **Demo data:** There are two boards, "Website relaunch" and "Home renovation", each with seven cards. Due dates are set relative to today, so one or two cards show as overdue.

I replaced the old Home/Settings screens and tab bar with the single board screen.
